youtube.title: They 'Flew' a Plane Without Leaving the Ground #Shorts
youtube.description:
How do you test a plane that has already crashed? You fly it without ever leaving the ground. After two Comet disasters, British investigators sank a whole airliner in a water tank and pumped it up and down to mimic flight after flight. After about three thousand flights' worth of cycles, the fuselage ripped open. That is metal fatigue: a tiny crack, growing silently. Full episode on the channel.

#Shorts #science #engineering #aviation #thehiddenwhy
